name: 49524-mixedtextimage-qwen3vl2b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct -- public, ungated, image-text-to-text, ~4 GB of bf16 safetensors.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine behind one OpenAI-compatible API server process.
architecture: multimodal dense decoder (Qwen3VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16): 28-layer language tower, hidden 2048, 16 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128; 24-layer vision tower behind Qwen3VLProcessor, patch 16, spatial merge 2.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup 25%, no cooldown, bounded at 960 requests with a 2400 s safety cap; 720 requests are measured, 540 of them text-only. Seed static 49524.
workload: a MIXED back-office chat stream over the OpenAI chat endpoint, driven from a file dataset (`configs/rows.jsonl`) in repeating blocks of four rows. Three rows are a short text-only ticket: a 115-token instruction preamble that is byte-identical on every one of them plus a distinct short tail, 147 prompt tokens through the chat template. The fourth carries one 1792x2528 JPEG page (`configs/pages/`, 66-88 KB, 18.9 MB in total) plus a 39-token extraction instruction, 4,473 prompt tokens. All 240 pages are distinct and each is sent exactly once. Every answer is pinned to exactly 64 tokens with `ignore_eos`.
purpose: A back-office ticket assistant handling short text queries and scanned page extractions, 48 concurrent streams, one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. The interpreter that runs it, and the hardware seal, are in
# configs/env.yaml. Every value is this commit's default except gpu-memory-utilization; see below.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# The longest request here is 4,473 prompt tokens plus 64 generated.
max-model-len: 8192

# Deliberately above scenario.json's 48 streams, so the operating point is the stream count.
max-num-seqs: 64

# AT MOST ONE picture per request. KEEP THIS VALUE ON ONE LINE as inline JSON: the config reader
# takes a value only from its key's own line and skips indented ones, so a block mapping is
# dropped whole and the engine silently falls back to the per-modality default.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

# NOT the engine default of 0.90, and it is the one deliberate departure in this file.
# 0.45 reserves 35.6 GiB of the 80 GB card. After ~4 GiB of bf16 weights and ~4 GiB of
# activations, profiling and CUDA graphs, that leaves a KV pool near 27 GiB -- about 258,000
# tokens at this checkpoint's 112 KiB/token. The workload holds ~62,000 tokens at 48 streams
# (twelve 4,473-token page rows beside thirty-six 147-token text rows, which is what the 3:1
# block order puts in flight), and ~97,000 even if page rows linger and skew the mix to twenty.
# The pool is not the operating point at 0.45 any more than it was at 0.90; what changes is only
# how much foreign memory the run can start beside -- 43.6 GiB instead of 7.9 GiB. See
# configs/note.md for why that matters here.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.45

# Engine defaults at this commit, written out so a later default cannot drift them.
mm-processor-cache-gb: 4
mm-processor-cache-type: lru
enable-prefix-caching: true
